images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Strategy puzzle map painted like a Joseon-era Korean ink-wash landscape (sansuhwa) at night: layered blue-green mountain peaks with dark ink outlines, textured brush strokes, small pine silhouettes, drifting mist bands, a silver river in the valley, a full moon with a soft halo. A diagonal mountain ridge runs from the northern border at top right down to a walled capital with curved tiled roofs at bottom left. On each peak sits a small stone beacon platform with five chimneys; the upper six are lit with two flames each and columns of black smoke, joined by a glowing golden signal line, and the sixth is just igniting while the lower three wait dark. Enemy tents with torches glow red beyond the border. Small hanji paper tags name each beacon. Right side: a hanji paper scroll panel on wooden rods, the code designer showing five chimney slots with two lit, smoke color buttons, meters and a code table. Korean UI: title '봉화 네트워크', '신호첩', '북방 기병 출현 · 국경 접근', button '봉화 올리기'. Deep indigo night, warm orange firelight, ivory hanji, vermillion seal accents, fine paper grain. Label constraints: the nine beacon tags along the ridge read 제1봉 to 제9봉 in order from the northern border (top right) down to the capital, each number exactly once with no repeats or gaps; 제1봉~제5봉 lit, 제6봉 just igniting, 제7봉~제9봉 dark.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same ink-wash Korean mountain beacon map in a violent night storm: slanted rain streaks over everything, heavy grey fog swallowing the lower slopes, desaturated slate-blue mountains, a lightning-lit cloud ceiling, no moon. The chain of beacon fires along the ridge burns from the top right down to the middle, then stops: the next platform is lost in fog, marked with a red X on a broken dashed line. Off the route, on a side peak, an unfamiliar beacon burns three reddish flames with red smoke inside a dashed red warning circle, a red dotted line leading from it to the capital, which now glows with three fires — the wrong message. A pale blue dashed detour route curves toward a coastal beacon. A pinned hanji note at top left compares sent and received codes with a red '오독' stamp. Right: hanji scroll titled '두절 보고' with four numbered decision options and a dark blue confirm button. Red banner at top: '학고개 봉수 두절'. Palette: storm blue-grey, sickly red, dim orange fire, ivory paper, dread and urgency. Object constraint: every beacon, including the fake one, is the same small stone platform with five chimneys as in screen A, and the number of lit chimneys is clearly readable (genuine chain shows two lit chimneys each, the fake beacon three); no wooden watchtowers.
